heroNarrative.title: The budget lands. Then the silence.
heroNarrative.lede: Every year the budget is read from the Treasury. Through BNS Connect we read, analyse, and interpret. In BNS Mashinani we verify in four counties. Wanahabari Lab delivers research-worthy reporting — all captured by BNS Studio.

thesis.title: Three bets. Year-round accountability.
thesis.body: Budget Ndio Story verifies what Treasury and counties publish, embeds where delivery happens, and trains newsrooms to stay forensic after Budget Day — so partners fund accountability they can brief and cite.

programmeExplains.name: BNS Connect
programmeExplains.title: National budget intelligence
programmeExplains.lede: We verify what Treasury publishes and keep national debt and allocation questions alive after Budget Day.
programmeExplains.success: Success looks like a baseline partners can fund and cite — AFRODAD debt forums, continental panels, continuous scrutiny.

programmeExplains.name: BNS Mashinani
programmeExplains.title: County delivery verification
programmeExplains.lede: Full-cycle embeds in Kakamega, Kilifi, Nakuru, and Wajir track whether equitable share reaches clinics, roads, and schools.
programmeExplains.success: Success looks like scorecards, town halls, and field briefings that show delivery — not estimates alone.

programmeExplains.name: Wanahabari Lab
programmeExplains.title: Newsroom scrutiny
programmeExplains.lede: Training and co-production keep journalists forensic after Budget Day — when the spending story actually begins.
programmeExplains.success: Success looks like investigations and launches partners can brief against — Red Flags, TERRA, newsroom-ready scrutiny.

featuredIntro.headline: Projects partners can brief against
featuredIntro.lede: Published films and convenings — AFRODAD debt forums, Red Flags, and Project TERRA — with local event photography as cover art. Titles stay fresh from YouTube; reach claims stay off the page.

partnerCta.title: Fund the bet that fits your mandate.
partnerCta.description: Co-fund national budget intelligence, county delivery verification, or newsroom scrutiny — with production captured through BNS Studio.

hero.body: Kenya's public money moves fast, and mostly out of sight. We turn opaque fiscal policy into verified intelligence for partners, institutions, and newsrooms — nationally and in select counties.

storyIntro.title: Featured programme evidence
storyIntro.body: House of Fiscal Wisdom with Dr. Lyla Latif — forensic briefing on illicit financial flows, produced with Wanahabari Lab as evidence partners can brief against.
